component.name: GenOffice
component.summary: AI-native office suite — Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and Markdown in one app

description.p: GenOffice is a unified, AI-native office suite. One local app hosts the word processor, spreadsheet, presentation and PDF modules behind a home launcher, reads and writes the standard Office file formats, and puts an AI copilot beside every editor.

ul.li: Docs: full-fidelity Word (.docx) editing with tracked changes, comments and export
Sheets: Excel (.xlsx) workbooks with formulas, charts and a native calculation sidecar
Slides: PowerPoint (.pptx) decks with presenter tools
PDF reading and markup, Markdown with live preview, and an HTML editor
An AI copilot in every editor: drafting, translation, summarization and image generation
A local-first design: files stay on disk, working offline
